avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces elvitegravir levels by 50%+, compromising antiretroviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Consider alternative mood support strategies.

avoid_supplements.name: Divalent Cations (Calcium, Magnesium, Iron, Zinc supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation complex formation reduces elvitegravir absorption by 40-50%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥2 hours. Counsel patient on timing relative to meals and supplements.

caution_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing products
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may moderately reduce elvitegravir concentrations; less significant than St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; dose adjustment may be needed if used together. Verify with prescriber.

avoid_foods.name: High-dose mineral-fortified foods (taken with drug)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Chelation with divalent cations impairs elvitegravir bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Take elvitegravir with food, then wait ≥2 hours before consuming fortified cereals, supplements.

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly increase elvitegravir absorption; effect is generally manageable
caution_foods.action: Consistent food intake recommended; no specific restriction needed if tolerated.

monitoring_notes: Elvitegravir requires chelation-aware counseling, particularly for divalent cation-containing supplements and fortified foods. Monitor for virologic response, especially if CYP3A4 inducers are suspected or if absorption concerns arise.
